title: Deposit withheld · English
input: I moved out of my rented flat in Indiranagar, Bengaluru on 15 September 2026. The landlord took ₹1,00,000 as deposit (10 months rent) and now says he will return only ₹40,000 because the walls need painting. He has stopped replying since 20 September. I have the rent agreement and bank transfer receipts.
raw:
You moved out on 15 September 2026, and your landlord in Bengaluru is wrongly withholding ₹60,000 of your ₹1,00,000 security deposit for painting without replying.

**Where you stand**
* You have clear written proof through your rent agreement and bank transfer receipts.
* Withholding a deposit without valid reason is a breach of agreement under [[ICA-73]].

**What you can do**
1. Send a written demand notice [[ICA-73]] to the landlord asking for the full balance within a set date.
2. If he refuses, you can approach the civil court to recover your money [[ICA-73]].

Would you like me to draft a demand letter to your landlord for the return of your deposit? Which state are you currently living in, and does your rent agreement have a clause about painting deductions?
